## 更新内容 / Changes

- 修复 Claude Code 会话“复制 ID”时误打开位置选择弹窗的问题；复制操作现在直接复制原始会话 ID。
- Claude Code 会话会收集同一会话记录中的多个工作目录。恢复时可选择一个仍存在且身份匹配的目录；预览和启动前都会重新核对会话来源及目录身份，目录被替换或记录变化时停止恢复。
- 适配 Codex 26.1016.51333 的普通 / Fast 菜单和本地 API 权限路径。Fast 使用客户端共享权限映射，并保留服务端明确的 Fast 拒绝；Ultra Fast 仍按独立能力判断。
- 收紧兼容性探测：只有能确认 Fast / Ultra Fast 来自客户端 `requirements.featureRequirements` 的映射才启用，未知或有歧义的结构保持原样并关闭补丁。

- Fixed Claude Code session ID copying so it copies the original session ID directly without briefly opening a location picker.
- Claude Code sessions retain every working directory recorded for a conversation. Resume lets the user choose a directory whose identity still matches, then revalidates the transcript source and directory before preview and launch. Replaced directories or changed session records are rejected.
- Adapted the Normal / Fast menu and local API entitlement path for Codex 26.1016.51333. Fast follows the client's shared entitlement mapper and preserves explicit server denial; Ultra Fast remains independently gated.
- Tightened capability detection so the compatibility patch is enabled only when Fast and Ultra Fast are confirmed to come from the client's `requirements.featureRequirements` mapping. Unknown or ambiguous structures fail closed.

## 下载与升级 / Downloads and upgrades

提供 macOS Apple Silicon（arm64）的 DMG / ZIP，附件包含 `SHA256SUMS.txt`。运行实例与账号、会话及本地配置会继续保留；安装更新前请等待运行中的实例和管理器完全退出。应用内自动更新尚未接入，安装包未进行 Developer ID 签名或公证。Windows、Linux 和其他架构尚未完成验证。

DMG and ZIP packages are available for macOS Apple Silicon (arm64), with `SHA256SUMS.txt`. Running instances, accounts, sessions and local settings are retained; wait until active instances and the manager have exited before installing an update. In-app updates, Developer ID signing and notarization are not included. Windows, Linux and other architectures have not been validated.

## 客户端支持 / Client support

Claude Code 会话管理适用于已支持的 macOS 官方原生 Claude Code CLI。会话浏览仍为本地记录；恢复仅适用于已停止的受管 CLI 实例，并使用所选的原始工作目录。Codex 26.1016.51333 的 API 界面可适配普通 / Fast；是否可用仍取决于模型和服务端权限。官方账号原生界面不注入此 API 菜单补丁。

Claude Code session management applies to the supported official native macOS Claude Code CLI. Session browsing uses local transcripts; resume is available for stopped managed CLI instances and uses the selected original working directory. The Codex 26.1016.51333 API interface supports Normal / Fast adaptation, subject to model and server entitlements. The patch does not modify the native official-account interface.

## 验证来源 / Verification

本版本已通过来源提交上的 GitHub Actions：源码 CI 与 Release workflow（包括 Go sidecar、完整源码回归、退出保活、Claude 管理 / 会话 UI、macOS arm64 安装包、打包验收及资产回读校验）均成功。本地完整回归包含 1433 项通过、0 项失败、4 项条件跳过；Fast 定向检查 52 项通过、0 项失败、4 项旧客户端 / preload 条件跳过。Codex 桌面普通、Fast 和 Ultra 请求使用隔离实例及 loopback 服务验证。当前客户端验证使用本机已安装 Codex 26.1016.51333 和隔离测试数据；不会使用真实账号凭据或发起付费模型请求。Claude 恢复验证使用合成会话和本地隔离项目目录，不代表真实付费上游验收。

GitHub Actions for this source commit passed the source CI and Release workflow, including Go sidecar, full source regression, manager quit / instance lifetime, Claude manager / session UI, macOS arm64 installer, packaged app verification and uploaded asset read-back checks. The local full regression has 1,433 passes, 0 failures and 4 conditional skips; focused Fast checks have 52 passes, 0 failures and 4 legacy client / preload conditional skips. Codex desktop Standard, Fast and Ultra requests were checked using isolated instances and a loopback service. Client validation uses the installed Codex 26.1016.51333 release and isolated test data; no real account credentials or paid model requests are used. Claude resume validation uses synthetic transcripts and isolated local project directories, not a paid upstream service.
